description: Audit of the scripts/router.py synonym map (KNOWN-ISSUES #9). A key stays only if skill text uses it for the canonical concept. tests/test_router_synonym_audit.py recomputes the rule against the current SKILL.md files and checks that SYNONYMS equals 'kept'.

method.passages: A skill's metadata (description before 'NOT for', capabilities, display name, slug) is one passage; each paragraph, list item and numbered step of the body is another. Fenced code, HTML comments, link targets, URLs and the References section are left out. Text is tokenised and Porter-stemmed like the router's input.
method.same-passage: some passage contains the key phrase (contiguous stems) and at least one canonical stem that is not part of the key. A one-word key must also be used that way in at least 50% of all passages that contain it (it is not mostly another sense in this library).
method.variant: spelling or inflection of a kept key, or of a metadata word, with the same canonical words
method.history: Round 1 (2026-10-29) kept any key that occurred anywhere in a skill's text, code included; review found that this does not show equivalence ('shift', 'bot', 'assistant', 'nan'). Round 2 applies the rule above to all 77 original keys.
method.dev_queries: number of dev-split queries containing the key; informational, never used in the decision. Test-split queries were not read.
